name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after a career in corporate IT. A lifelong interest in technology led her to volunteer her skills at a local racing team, where she quickly realized the critical role of robust IT systems in modern racing. Her ability to quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues made her an invaluable asset.

At Garage 59, Klara is responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of all IT infrastructure, from data acquisition systems to communication networks. She takes a proactive approach, anticipating potential problems and implementing preventative measures. Her colleagues appreciate her calm demeanor under pressure and her dedication to finding innovative solutions. 

Klara is known for her ability to translate complex technical jargon into plain language, making her an excellent communicator and team player.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob with a slight wave.
physical.description: Klara has a kind face framed by her neatly styled hair and piercing blue eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with IT diagrams and ideas.
Has a habit of humming quietly while debugging code.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard with loud, clicky keys.
